Korrelációs együttható (r, −1…+1): az ad: Correlation coefficient (r, −1…+1): how the factor’s level moves together with the weight or fat change in the same period. Positive: they rise together; negative: they move in opposite directions. It needs at least 20 shared days, and correlation doesn’t prove causation – a single unusual week (illness, travel) can have a strong effect. Body fat measurements (especially on home scales) are noisy, so read that column with more caution.
